context:
It saves Riftbound's current prices once each time TCGCSV updates, so a whole-market price history builds from now on. It is a free download and changes no price.
It passed three review rounds. A failed read goes to a note file and the job log; no screen shows it yet.
The full CI run starts when it is marked ready.

options.gain: Price history starts building today; every day of delay is a day of history lost.
options.how: Mark it ready, then merge once CI passes.
options.label: Merge on green
options.lose: A failed read shows on no screen yet.

options.gain: Time to look first, or to wait for a screen that shows failures.
options.label: Hold

ref: PR 977 (daily read of TCGCSV's Riftbound prices); D322, TCGCSV is the next price source
title: Merge the daily Riftbound price read once CI is green?
why: History only builds forward, so each day held is lost, and the read spends nothing.
